gloss_en: I want to send you an email now
notes: [tech] email→imeːl; /eː/ mid-long loan vowel in ar-SY inventory (almbark2015 §1.1). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

sentence: اشْتَرَيْت laptop جْدِيد بَسّ wifi ضَعِيف عِنَّا
raw: اشتريت laptop جديد بس wifi ضعيف عنا
ipa: iʃtaˈreːt labtub ˈʒdiːd ˈbass wifi dˤɑˈʕiːf ˈʕinnaː
gloss_en: I bought a new laptop but our wifi is weak
notes: [tech] laptop→labtub (/p/→[b], Al-Saidat 2011); wifi→wifi. table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: the printer is broken, we must fix it tomorrow
notes: [tech] printer→brintar (initial /p/→[b], the ar-SY nativisation delta; Al-Saidat 2011). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

sentence: شُفْت video كْتِير حِلُو عَنِ الشَّام
raw: شفت video كتير حلو عن الشام
ipa: ˈʃuft fidiu ˈktiːr ˈħiluː ˈʕani ˈʃʃaːm
gloss_en: I saw a very nice video about Damascus
notes: [tech] video→fidiu (/v/→[f]; ar-SY has no /v/, Cowell 1964 ch.1). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I forgot the password of the email
notes: [tech] password→baswuːrd (/p/→[b]; medial embed). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I paid the bill in cash, not by card
notes: [commerce] cash→kaʃ (final embed; muː negation, cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

sentence: فِي offer مْنِيح وْ discount كْبِير عَالْمَحَلّ
raw: في offer منيح و discount كبير عالمحل
ipa: ˈfiː ufar ˈmniːħ w disawnt ˈkbiːr ʕaːlmaˈħall
gloss_en: there is a good offer and a big discount at the shop
notes: [commerce] offer→ufar; discount→disawnt; mnīḥ 'good' Damascene (cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

sentence: delivery بْيُوصَل بُكْرَا إِنْ شَاءَ الله
raw: delivery بيوصل بكرا إن شاء الله
ipa: dilifari ˈbjuːsˤɑl ˈbukraː ˈʔin ˈʃaːʔa ˈallah
gloss_en: the delivery arrives tomorrow, God willing
notes: [commerce] delivery→dilifari (/v/→[f]; initial embed; b-imperfect byūṣal). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: sorry, I was a bit late for you
notes: [daily] sorry→suːri (sentence-initial discourse loan). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: the charger of the mobile is broken
notes: [automotive] charger→ʃaːrdʒar (/tʃ/→[ʃ], the ar-SY delta; Al-Saidat 2011; ǧīm [dʒ]). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I spoke with the company manager yesterday
notes: [work] manager→manadʒar (ǧīm kept [dʒ] vs Cairene [manaɡar]; Watson 2002). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

sentence: أَنَا think هَادَا model غَالِي كْتِير
raw: أنا think هادا model غالي كتير
ipa: ˈʔanaː θink ˈhaːdaː mudil ˈɣaːliː ˈktiːr
gloss_en: I think this model is very expensive
notes: [opinion] think→θink (interdental /θ/ RETAINED in ar-SY vs Cairene [t]; cowell1964); model→mudil. table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I took the microbus to the university
notes: [transport] Arabic-script loan sarfīs 'service/microbus' [sarˈfiːs] (/v/→[f] integrated; cowell1964); pipeline reads native graphemes → matches attested. table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: do you want to pay cash or by card
notes: [commerce] Arabic-script loan kāš [kaːʃ], attested Levantine loan; pipeline matches attested. table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: the car is automatic, not manual
notes: [automotive] loan ōtōmātīk; attested colloquial [ʔotomaˈtiːk] with /oː/ for و; pipeline reads و as /uː/ → ˈʔuːtuːmaˈːtiːk (WRONG); full pipeline: 'assaˈjjaːra ʔuːtuːmaˈːtiːk ˈmuː ˈʕaːdiː'. table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I lost my mobile in the market
notes: [tech] loan mōbāyil; attested [moˈbaːjil] with /oː/ for و; pipeline reads و as /uː/ → lmuˈːbaːjil (WRONG); full pipeline: 'ˈdˤɑːʕ ˈminniː lmuˈːbaːjil biˈlssuːʔ'. table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: the new television is very big
notes: [tech] loan tilifizyōn; attested [tilifizˈjoːn] with /oː/ for يون; pipeline reads و as /uː/ → attilifiˈzjuːn (WRONG); full pipeline: 'attilifiˈzjuːn aˈlʒdiːd ˈkbiːr ˈktiːr'. table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

ipa: ˈkiːfak ˈjaː ħaˈbiːbiː ˈkil ˈʃiː taˈmaːm
gloss_en: how are you my dear? is everything ok?
notes: [arabizi] 3arabi spelling of كيفك يا حبيبي؟ كل شي تمام؟ (7=/ħ/); pipeline has no Arabizi path → hand-derived from the Damascene reading (kīfak, cowell1964; ay→eː absent here). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I'm going to the university now
notes: [arabizi] spelling of عم روح عالجامعة هلق (3=/ʕ/, 7=/ħ/, 2=/ʔ/); progressive ʕam (cowell1964 p.320); ǧīm [dʒ]→here [ʒ]; hallaʔ 'now'. table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: how are you doing today? fine, thank God
notes: [arabizi] spelling of شو عامل اليوم؟ منيح الحمدلله (3=/ʕ/, 7=/ħ/); mnīḥ 'fine' Damascene (cowell1964); aljoːm ay→eː? here /oː/. table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)
